environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). PgBouncer in transaction pooling mode on port 6432 proxying to PostgreSQL 15. No rate limiting, no WAF. Application directly exposed via NLB TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at the application level. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
